paragraphs.text: Kor Haven was a settlement for the kor of Rath , which was planeshifted to Dominaria during the Rathi Overlay .
Kor Haven was carved directly out of the flowstone cliffs and pillars of Rath , and housed countless numbers of the plane's kor .
During the Rathi Overlay , Kor Haven was shifted to the Balduvian Steppe of the Terisian Isles .
